title: CUDA Python explicit launch
purpose: Compile an original header-free CUDA C++ kernel to PTX, explicitly link cubin, launch from Python with owned buffers and a stream, and check every output against a CPU reference.

build.cachePolicy: ProgramOptions.no_cache=True, LinkerOptions.no_cache=True and CUDA_CACHE_DISABLE=1. NVRTC's default cache invokes cuInit; it is disabled before imports/compilation.
build.driverLibraryInBuild: Core 1.2.0 Program.compile('ptx') queries cuDriverGetVersion without cuInit; a real userspace driver library is required even on a GPU-free compilation host.

correctness.referenceType: Python float computed from stored ctypes.c_float input values
correctness.sizePolicy: Reject zero, negative, noninteger and over-budget sizes before CUDA imports; n is passed as ctypes.c_uint32.
correctness.outputInitialization: Copy a pinned-host NaN sentinel array to the device output before launch so missed writes cannot pass by chance.
correctness.comparisonRule: After stream.sync(), check all n outputs; reject any nonfinite output/reference or exact inequality. Count every mismatch and report the first failing index. Exact equality is justified only for these binary-exact FP32 inputs and sums.

compatibility.architecturePolicy: Plain numeric CC >=75 AND membership in the loaded NVRTC supported-architecture list; run selects device 0's exact architecture. Never silently retarget or use architecture suffixes.

pythonEnvironment.nativeDependencyMode: NVIDIA Debian packages on Ubuntu 24.04; no runfile or native CUDA pip installation profile
pythonEnvironment.packageGate: All six declared packages must have exact installed status, amd64 architecture and pinned Debian versions, including cuda-compiler-13-3 and cuda-command-line-tools-13-3 at 13.3.1-1. Canonical resolved binary paths must be owned only by the declared packages.

nvcc.installationNote: NVCC is not invoked by EX21, but the compiler metapackage and its installation dependencies are mandatory for this profile.

driver.newerCompatible: Other driver coordinates are outside this exact package profile. Run requires the kernel module to match the loaded 610.43.02 userspace library.

pythonEnvironment.versionBoundary: Installed NVIDIA Debian package status, versions and actual binary ownership establish the installation coordinate. NVRTC and nvJitLink APIs expose 13.3, not patch 33. After compilation, record NVRTC-builtins from /proc/self/maps and check its path, hash and ownership against cuda-nvrtc-13-3 13.3.33-1; never infer its loaded identity from NVRTC. Local package records and file hashes still require authenticated installation provenance. Driver API level is not driver package identity.

expectedObservations: The GPU-free build should produce PTX for compute_75 and a nonempty nvJitLink cubin with the original kernel's sm_75 SASS, without initializing a device/context or launching work.
The default run should submit four blocks of 256 threads for 1003 values; 21 tail threads should take the bounds guard.
After checked stream completion, every output should be finite and exactly equal to its CPU reference. CPU reference values should also match the independent literals.
Owned buffers should close on their submission stream before draining frees and closing that stream; logs and the first failure should survive cleanup attempts.
